verses.text:

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the mail truck idles at the curb
someone's name called twice, then let go

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
she folds the letter back into its silence

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
dust settles on the piano keys
a child hums the tune anyway, unasked

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the porch light flickers on for no one
moths arrive like they were invited

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the neighbor's dog stops barking mid-thought
somewhere a screen door decides to stay open

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning frost erases the tire tracks
someone still swears they saw the car turn left

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the vending machine hums its one note
change clatters through like it knows the way home

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the bus stops where no one is waiting
the driver counts it as arriving anyway

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth circles the porch light twice
then makes its decision without us

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the receipt in my pocket lists everything but the reason
I keep it anyway, folded smaller each week
